description: After a Turin court cancels Lidia Poët's admission to the bar because she is a woman, she refuses to stop practicing and begins solving cases unofficially through her brother Enrico's law office. A murdered ballerina, an accused anarchist, a family confession, a suspicious death after a séance and other cases sharpen her methods while journalist Jacopo draws her into both investigation and romance. Her appeal against disbarment grows alongside the cases, turning each victory into part of a larger fight for the right to practice law.

s01e01.description: Ballerina Adele Valery is murdered and her alleged stalker Pietro Baiocchi is arrested, prompting his mother to seek Lidia's help just as a Turin court removes Lidia from the bar because she is a woman. Working through Enrico's office, Lidia reconstructs Adele's relationships and final movements, clears Pietro and proves that losing her license has not ended her legal career.

s01e02.description: Anita Tosetti, an anarchist employed at a chocolate factory, is accused of murdering Elena De Santis. Lidia discovers that Elena secretly held authority inside the factory and had a personal relationship with Anita, and the resulting investigation exposes a motive that the police case ignored while further angering officials already determined to keep Lidia out of court.

s01e03.description: Vittorio Muraro appears at Lidia's former family home in an opium haze and confesses to killing his father years earlier. Lidia and Enrico reopen the old house, find a concealed room and uncover letters about debt, marriage and a missing necklace that reshape both the murder case and their understanding of their own father's past.

s01e04.description: Chemist Margherita Sangiacomo faces execution for murdering Professor Braschi, and Lidia initially works to prove her innocent. The evidence instead shows that Margherita killed him in revenge for medical experiments on poor women and prostitutes, including her mother, forcing Lidia to choose truth over an easy acquittal.

s01e05.description: Azzurra, a prostitute, is accused of killing wealthy client Achille Castelnuovo after a séance and party. Lidia follows the evidence through the household and the medium Vera to identify the person who actually killed Castelnuovo, while Jacopo's own investigation leaves him exposed to arrest.

s01e06.description: Jacopo is arrested for the murder of Maya Cristallo, whose real identity links her to French anarchists Nicole and Louis. Lidia discovers that Maya had betrayed them while working as a government spy, confronts the fugitives on a train and clears Jacopo, only to learn that the Court of Cassation has rejected her appeal against disbarment.
